title: Any way to make it so I unlock more powerful skills through combat?

posts.author: GuardianofRidgewood
posts.body:
Hey all! I was wondering if there was a way I could make it so I'll unlock more powerful skills and special attacks by using certain skills and special attacks X amount of times during combat? Specifically through in game triggers or something?
For example: if I were to use fireball 10 times, can I make it so I'll unlock fireball level 2 or something along those lines for whichever character fulfills that requirement?

posts.author: kirbwarrior
posts.body:
The simplest way without plugins or using the Damage Formula would be to have Fireball call up a Common Event that does everything you want. It can increase a given variable by one, then check if the variable us (say) 10 or higher and if it is, teaches the first Actor Fireball 2.
If you want the player to have control over the requirements and have this apply to any given character, you'll likely want to find a plugin.
